### Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – October 20, 2026

#### Bug Fix Update

This is a bug fix update. Replay codes have been wiped.

#### Bug Fixes

General

* Fixed an issue preventing the challenge "Not so Thankless" from being completed by thanking Sombra.
* Fixed a bug where DualSense controllers were not working properly on PC.
